It is also a great way to gain insight into the Maine Plastic Surgery philosophy and surgical approach. Articles Articles Dr. Gardenier is passionate about sharing his knowledge and experience with the world, and contributes frequently to industry publications and peer-reviewed journals, as well as popular news outlets. Here you can browse through recent articles on a variety of topics in cosmetic surgery. Videos Videos For some of our clients, watching a video about a procedure is much more rewarding and educational than reading pages off of a website. Dr. Gardenier understands this and has assembled a library of videos about a wide range of treatments and topics in cosmetic surgery for your viewing convenience.
